title: Neural Renormalization Group Flow for Percolation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning offers a possible route to data-driven real-space renormalization when the relevant observables are nonlocal and difficult to prescribe explicitly. We explore this idea for two-dimensional site percolation developping a supervised, scale-shared neural architecture. The model recursively applies the same learned coarse-graining rule across scales, producing a latent field from which the crossing probability is predicted, while a corresponding fine-graining decoder reconstructs the largest-cluster mask. Trained only on small lattices, the model extrapolates to substantially larger systems, recovers the spanning cluster with high fidelity, and produces observables obeying the expected finite-size scaling near the critical point. translated_title: 神经重整化群流用于逾渗问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26764v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当相关观测量是非局部的且难以显式规定时，机器学习为数据驱动的实空间重整化提供了一条可能的途径。我们针对二维格点逾渗探索了这一思想，开发了一种有监督的、尺度共享的神经架构。该模型在多个尺度上递归应用相同的学习粗粒化规则，生成一个潜在场，从中预测穿越概率，同时相应的细粒化解码器重建最大簇掩码。仅在小格点上训练，该模型能外推到显著更大的系统，高保真地恢复跨越簇，并产生在临界点附近符合预期有限尺寸标度的观测量。我们观察到，要实现这种性能，关键在于学习到的潜在表示表现出临界涨落和与重整化群结构一致的尺度依赖流。
tldr: 本文提出一种尺度共享的神经架构，通过递归粗粒化学习潜在表示，在小格点训练后能高保真外推至大系统，并恢复逾渗临界标度行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scale-shared neural architecture that recursively coarse-grains to learn latent representations, enabling high-fidelity extrapolation to larger systems and recovery of percolation critical scaling behavior after training on small lattices.
